Name: A Siamese cat that can be ridden like a horse
Author: xiaojingcat
Description:
我制作了一个.XNB文件，用于替换游戏原本的horse.XNB;将马的贴图改为由我绘制的、我家喜欢跑步的猫咪——一只名为小井的暹罗猫。
使用方法：打开steam-库-右键星露谷物语-管理-浏览本地文件-Content-Animals，然后把下载的新的horse.XNB拖进去替换之前的horse.XNB（之前的horse.XNB记得存备份）
附：小井的两只后爪有白化，喂他吃胡萝卜显示的是小井吃他最喜欢的磨牙棒。
第一次做很简单的皮肤模组，感谢您的喜欢~

I created an .XNB file to replace the game's original horse.XNB; I changed the horse's texture to a drawing of my Siamese cat named Xiaojing, who loves running.

Usage: Open Steam - Library - right-click on Stardew Valley - Manage - Browse Local Files - Content - Animals, then drag the downloaded new horse.XNB into the folder (remember to back up the original horse.XNB first).

P.S.: Xiaojing has albinism on its two hind paws. When you feed it a carrot, it will show Xiaojing eating its favorite teething stick.

This is my first time making a simple skin mod. Thank you for liking it~
